$comment: Lock derivation contract, shared by the Go backend and every frontend. The backend is authoritative — a block on the wire always carries a computed lock_level — but frontends need the same rule to build blocks optimistically. Both sides run the cases below as a test table; a divergence is a test failure, not a surprise in production.

classTitle.pattern: （课）|课$|课程|讲座|实验课|导论|Lecture|Lab\s*课
classTitle.$comment: pattern is byte-identical to the JS original. Apply it case-insensitively to the trimmed title. Go wraps it as (?i)(?:<pattern>) because RE2 scopes a flag group to its enclosing group.

defaultReasonNote: zh-CN is the design original, verbatim. en-US is a working translation and is NOT final — it needs sign-off before shipping (copy is frozen by project rule).

soft.en-US: Time you agreed with someone else

levels: never derived — DeriveLock still has work to do
levels.soft: agreed with someone else; moving needs confirmation
levels.hard: set by a timetable; the user cannot move it

sources.derived: inferred from type + title; safe to recompute
sources.agent: set by the agent; never recompute

movable.$comment: Who may change a block's time. The agent plans around locks rather than being blocked by them; system must pass or revert could not undo a lock change. `confirmed` comes from the request, never from the block.

cases.title: 数学课
cases.why: trailing space is trimmed before matching

cases.title: 复习课程笔记
cases.why: type wins — a task is never locked even if the title matches
empty title is not a class

knownDivergencesNote: Verified by running both engines, not reasoned about. Note that a non-ASCII space only diverges when 课 is NOT the last character — otherwise the 课$ branch matches on both sides and hides the difference ('Lab　课' is hard everywhere). Accepted rather than patched: the pattern stays verbatim, and the server is authoritative so a client is corrected within one round-trip. Do NOT 'fix' these by editing the pattern — that forks it from the design original.

knownDivergences.why: U+3000 ideographic space between Lab and 课. JavaScript's \s matches it, RE2's \s is ASCII-only ([\t\n\f\r ]). 课 is not final, so the 课$ branch does not rescue it.
U+00A0 no-break space — same cause as above.
